title: English Practice Quiz 0896
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A payment voucher is used to ___.
questions.explanation: document and authorise a payment is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A credit note generally reduces ___.
options: the amount owed by a customer
questions.explanation: the amount owed by a customer is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A petty cash register records ___.
questions.explanation: small cash payments and balances is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A bank reconciliation compares ___.
options: organisation cash records with the bank statement
questions.explanation: organisation cash records with the bank statement is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: An overdue invoice is one that ___.
options: has not been paid by its due date
questions.explanation: has not been paid by its due date is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A purchase budget sets out ___.
questions.explanation: planned spending limits for purchases is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A supporting receipt helps verify ___.
options: that an expense was incurred and paid
questions.explanation: that an expense was incurred and paid is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A duplicate payment should be ___.
options: investigated and corrected through the finance process
questions.explanation: investigated and corrected through the finance process is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A cost centre classifies expenses by ___.
questions.explanation: department or activity is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Before reimbursing an expense, verify ___.
questions.explanation: eligibility, approval and supporting documents is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.
